# MusicXML

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:notationMusicXML`](gmeow-notationMusicXML.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/notationMusicXML>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The W3C MusicXML 4.0 symbolic music interchange format. Lossy: microtones via bare decimal alter, polymeter via implementation-dependent hacks, no mobile-form traversal semantics.
